title: Findings
description: The finding list in the web app with filters for state, source, world, and date.

title: Evidence replay
description: A 3D replay of how a symbol was built, block by block, with the players who placed the blocks.

title: Public evidence link
description: The public replay page of a confirmed finding. It needs no sign-in and hides the world name and coordinates.

title: Heatmap
description: The detail view of a finding with the heatmap of the blocks the model relied on.

title: 3D terrain
description: The 3D view of the terrain around a finding with the heatmap overlay.

title: Statistics
description: Findings per day, precision per detection path, and reviews per staff member.
